answer:
According to the retrieved standard operating procedure [SOP-M-104_centrifugal_pump_maintenance.md], for a centrifugal pump showing elevated vibration according to ISO 10816-3 Class II (Zone C / Warning: 4.5 - 7.1 mm/s RMS), the recommended inspection and maintenance procedure is to:

"Schedule maintenance and overhaul as per SOP-M-104, Section 3: Vibration & Condition Monitoring Thresholds."

This is stated in the document as follows:

"**Zone C / Warning (4.5 - 7.1 mm/s RMS)**: Elevated vibration indicating bearing degradation, cavitation, or unbalance. Schedule maintenance and overhaul as per SOP-M-104, Section 3: Vibration & Condition Monitoring Thresholds."
